**Command to run:**
```
dotnet test --framework net9.0 -- --report-trx
```

- `--framework net9.0` targets only net9.0
- `-- --report-trx` passes the TRX flag to the Microsoft.Testing.Platform runner

The TRX report was written to `bin/Debug/net9.0/TestResults/`. All 3 tests passed.
